player_prompt.intro:
Wezi Player {player_id} mu mchezo wa {max_rounds} round wa Kuhn Poker.
Zithunzi za mchezo:
- Kuhn Poker imachita kweni dekhi ya kadi 3 yeneyi J, Q, K (J ndi ya chifukwa, K ndi ya kuwala)
- Wachiwiri wosekula {ante} chip ndi kupokea kadi 1 kwa round (gawani kwamba kadi zikupangwa bwanji, sizipanga kadi moza ndi wapinzani wako).
- Mchezo unakwenda {max_rounds} magulu
- Wachiwiri ali ndi chip zingati pambuyo pa magulu onse anawina
Zithunzi za galimbe:
- '[check]': Lumba bwanji usale chip (ngati palibe chip pamwamba)
- '[bet]': Onjezera chip 1 kweni poti (ngati palibe chip pamwamba)
- '[call]': Linganisa galimbe la mpinzani wako kwa kuonjeza chip 1 kweni poti
- '[fold]': Ize kadi yako ndi ulete mpinzani wako asamble poti

init_round.round_start: ### Kupezeka kwa round {current_round} kati ka {max_rounds} magulu. Kadi yako ndi: '{player_card}'
